children: VSE said it acquired Atech Turbine Components, a company providing maintenance, repair and overhaul services for aircraft turbine engines.

The aviation aftermarket distribution and repair services firm on Monday said that Atech will add upward of 300 specialized and proprietary repair approvals to VSE's offerings, particularly for engines made by Pratt & Whitney Canada.

"By adding Atech to VSE, we are expanding the breadth of solutions we provide to our OEM partners and customers while creating another attractive platform for long-term organic growth," Chief Executive John Cuomo said.
VSE plans to expand Atech's capacity and capabilities substantially, it said.
Financial terms of the deal weren't disclosed.
